## LotLift SalesPilot

- SalesPilot now composes normal prospect responses with current call context instead of rigid objection routing.
- Gatekeeper, right-person discovery, workflow gaps, meeting requests, and safe exits remain explicitly protected.
- Model failures safely fall back to the approved local response.

### Install on Mac

Download the `.dmg`, open it, then drag **Parley** into **Applications**. Open Parley from Applications.
